description: News search API: current news on any topic in any language from the GDELT Project, which reads the world's press every 15 minutes. Titles matched in their original script, newest first, with publisher, language and link; filter to one language; a US stock ticker searches the company's name. Window up to 30 days (default 72 hours). Input: query and/or symbol; optional language, limit, since_hours. $0.25 per call.
name: hubvibe_news_search
title: Current news on any topic, in any language
